findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the quat based sanitizer in the three part sink was observed low on the inspector’s test strips. Per employees the dish machine is not used on Fridays (today) meaning that the three part sink is the only dish cleaning method being utilized today. The PIC stated that it was about time to change out the water anyway and did so during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective concentrations at all times.
